paragraphs.text: Per-session environment selector for DeepSeek Harness: Python / R / CLI slots from conda, standalone
R, WSL, or custom paths, via /env, session_env, DSH_ENV_* facts, and a header dropdown.
# dsh-envsel
English | 中文
Session environment selector for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). Per-language slots — Python, R, CLI tools —
each hold one first-priority environment drawn from **conda**, **standalone R** installs, **WSL** d
istributions, or **user-pinned custom paths**. Selections are per-session, persisted across restarts
, and take effect for the model from the very next turn.
This is a **standalone, npm-installable DSH plugin**. It installs with `dsh plugin add` — no source
patching, no monorepo checkout.
## Features

- **`/env` command** — read, assign, clear, and list environments from the chat.
- **`session_env` m

odel tool** — the agent can list, select, pin, and unpin environments on its own.
- **Per-turn runti
me-context block** — the selection is restated in the model's runtime context on every turn, so the
model reads which environment this session runs in instead of having to think to ask. A session with
no selection of its own — a delegated subagent, for example — inherits the nearest selecting sessio

n it descends from.
- **States the R that a conda env also carries** — when the selected Python envi
ronment ships `Rscript` of its own, the runtime block says so (`- This environment also provides R:
…`). conda environments routinely carry R beside Python, and without that line the model only sees t
he R slot and can mix two different R installations. It is omitted when the same install fills both

slots.
- **`DSH_ENV_*` shell facts** — every shell call sees `DSH_ENV_PYTHON`, `DSH_ENV_RSCRIPT`, `D

SH_ENV_CLI_PREFIX` for the session's selection.
- **Header dropdown** — a per-language selector in t
he conversation header (Python / R / CLI tools), with an "Add path" form to pin any interpreter or i

nstall directory.
- **Cross-platform discovery** — conda environments, standalone R (Windows `Progra
m Files`, macOS framework + Homebrew, Linux `/opt/R`), WSL distributions on Windows, and manually pi

nned paths. WSL scanning is skipped automatically on non-Windows hosts.
- **Bilingual UI** — product
copy (the `/env` command, the header dropdown, and discovery warnings) follows the DSH interface la
nguage: English by default, Chinese when the DSH language preference is set to 中文.
## Requirements
- DeepSeek Harness **0.1.7-rc.1 or newer** (the web profile), which now includes the **0.2.0-rc** li
ne: every `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` peer is declared as `^0.1.7-rc.1 || ^0.2.0-rc.1`. Verified on **0.1.7
-rc.2**; the range also admits `0.2.0-rc.1`, `0.2.0-rc.2` and `0.2.1-alpha.2`. DSH skips a plugin bu
ndle whose `@deepseek-ai/dsh*` peer range excludes the running runtime, so that range — not a versio

n probe — decides whether this plugin loads.
- `pnpm` on PATH (used by `dsh plugin`).
## DSH version compatibility
| Plugin | DeepSeek Harness | Why |
| **0.3.1** | **0.2.0-rc.1 or newer** for the runtime-context block; still loads on 0.1.7-rc.1+ with
out it | Adds the "- This environment also provides R: …" line, so a selected conda Python environme
nt that ships its own `Rscript` is reported instead of being invisible next to the R slot. Rendering

only — no new DSH API. |
| **0.3.0** | **0.2.0-rc.1 or newer** for the runtime-context block; still
loads on 0.1.7-rc.1+ without it | Renders the selection into the per-turn runtime context and lets
a session with no selection inherit the nearest selecting session it descends from, so delegated sub
agents keep their parent's environment. The block is contributed through `systemPrompt.context()`, w
hose text provider receives the assembling agent as `AssembleContext.agent` — a binding DSH gained i
.0-rc: every `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` peer now also admits `^0.2.0-rc.1`, so the startup compatibility g
ate no longer skips the bundle. The 18 peers were still pinned to `^0.1.7-rc.1`, whose `<0.2.0` uppe

r bound rejects a 0.2.x runtime. |
| **0.1.6** | **0.1.7-rc.1 or newer** | Fixes the header dropdown
on 0.1.7: that release renamed the UI icon set (`IconCheckOutline14` became `IconCheckOutlineRegula

r`), so 0.1.5's button rendered an undefined element and the slot entry crashed. |
| 0.1.5 | 0.1.7-r
c.1 or newer | Emits strict Typert codecs with the `create()` factory that 0.1.7-rc.1 introduced. Ho

st-side surfaces (`/env`, `session_env`, `DSH_ENV_*`) work; the header dropdown does not. |
| 0.1.3
and earlier (published) | 0.1.0-rc.7 through 0.1.5-rc.x | Emits the eager `schema` instance those lo
ished) | 0.1.0-rc.7 through 0.1.5-rc.x | Emits the eager `schema` instance those loaders validate. |

The model can manage selections itself with `action=list|get|set|pin|unpin`.
## Known limitations
- **The runtime-context block needs DSH 0.2.0-rc.1 or newer.** It is contributed through `systemProm
pt.context()`, and the text provider is handed the assembling agent as `AssembleContext.agent` — a b
inding DSH added in 0.2.0-rc.1. On 0.1.7-rc the block renders nothing and the selection reaches the
model only as `DSH_ENV_*` shell facts plus `/env` and `session_env`; nothing else changes. Set `regi

sterContext: false` to turn the block off on any host.
- **Peer-bound to the 0.1.7-rc and 0.2.0-rc l
ines.** The plugin declares every `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` peer as `^0.1.7-rc.1 || ^0.2.0-rc.1` and is v
erified up to `0.1.7-rc.2`; the 0.2.0-rc line is covered by that range. On DSH 0.1.0-rc.7 through 0.
1.5-rc.x install `@beihaizb/dsh-envsel@0.1.3` (the last release published for that line) instead; a
future DSH release that changes these APIs — or the Typert artifact contract again — needs a matchin
g plugin update. On a line the peer range does not admit, grant an exact-version exemption (`dsh plu

gin allow-version`, or the plugin manager) rather than forcing the install.
- **Selections are not p
art of the session log.** They survive restarts in `envsel-state.json` but are not replayed from (or
carried by) session logs.
